Context-Aware Rendering

accessibility:
- Trigger uses `role="combobox"` with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls`.
- Popover panel has `role="dialog"` with an accessible name.
- Calendar uses `role="grid"` with cells as `role="gridcell"`.
- Cells expose `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled`, and `aria-current="date"` for today.
- Roving `tabindex` keeps a single grid cell focusable at a time.
- Honors `prefers-reduced-motion` (skip popover fade-in).
summary: The `DateInput` component is a form input that opens a popover calendar for date selection.

parts.summary: The `DateInput` component is a form input that opens a popover calendar for date selection.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label (component auto-wraps in a `Field` if not already inside). Automatically associated with the input via `htmlFor` — uses your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. Not wired in `inline` mode (no visible input to label) and dropped inside an outer `Field`.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then).

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Render the field with horizontal layout.

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Icon props for the left icon.

props.name: iconRight
props.description: Icon props for the right icon.

props.name: iconRightName
props.description: Shortcut for the right icon name.

props.name: iconLeftSize
props.description: Shortcut for left icon size.

props.name: iconRightSize
props.description: Shortcut for right icon size.

props.name: hasIconsLeft
props.description: Force the left icon container.

props.name: hasIconsRight
props.description: Force the right icon container.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Show a loading indicator on the control.

props.name: isExpanded
props.description: Expand the control to fill its container.

props.name: controlSize
props.description: Size of the wrapping Control.

props.name: message
props.description: Help/validation text below the input.

props.name: messageColor
props.description: Color modifier for the help message.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Control wrapper.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial date for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired when the value changes.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fired when the popover opens.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when the popover closes.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Make the input read-only.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the input.

props.name: format
props.description: Token format string or `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options. Default `'YYYY-MM-DD'`.

props.name: parse
props.description: Custom parser (use when `format` is `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions`).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale tag for day/month names and Intl formatting.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render the calendar inline (no popover).

props.name: mobileNative
props.description: Use `<input type="date">` on coarse-pointer + small-viewport devices.

props.name: editable
props.description: Allow segmented keyboard typing in the input (type the date directly, auto-advancing across segments). `false` makes the field picker-only.

props.name: popover
props.description: Whether the calendar popover exists. `false` makes the field input-only (segmented typing, no popover).

props.name: openOnFocus
props.description: Open the popover when the input is focused.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the popover after a date is selected.

props.name: position
props.description: Popover anchor position relative to the input.

props.name: appendToBody
props.description: Render the popover into `document.body` via portal.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant.

props.name: isRounded
props.description: Render the input with rounded corners.

props.name: shouldDisableDate
props.description: Predicate to disable specific dates (e.g. weekends). Blocked dates are also rejected during manual typing.

props.name: unselectableDates
props.description: Convenience array of disabled dates; merged with `shouldDisableDate`. Matched by calendar day and also rejected during manual typing.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: Day the week starts on (0 = Sunday).

props.name: dayNames
props.description: Override the 7 day-name labels (in calendar order, post-rotation).

props.name: monthNames
props.description: Override the 12 month-name labels.

props.name: nearbyMonthDays
props.description: Show dimmed dates from adjacent months in the grid.

props.name: iconLeftName
props.description: Decorative left icon glyph for the wrapping `Control` (shown by default). Set `''` to hide.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: Show a clickable launcher button on the right that toggles the popover. Default `true`.

props.name: triggerIconName
props.description: Glyph for the right launcher button.

props.name: labels
props.description: Optional translatable string overrides (ARIA labels, button text).

extraProps.name: name
extraProps.description: Form field name. Forwarded to a hidden ISO-formatted input.

extraProps.name: form
extraProps.description: Form id the input belongs to.

extraProps.name: className
extraProps.description: Additional CSS classes for the input.
